info.name: ACK St. Mary's Kabete LMS - API Gateway
info.description: Full route coverage for the api-gateway (port 8000), with a pm.test() assertion block on every request. Run 'Auth > Login' first - it has an auto-listener test script that captures {{access_token}}/{{refresh_token}} automatically, so every other request (Bearer auth is inherited at the collection level) just works. Tests use realistic status-code allowlists (e.g. [200, 403, 404]) so the collection can run green against a freshly-seeded/empty database, while still failing loudly on a genuine 500/502 — that's how this collection caught 3 real backend bugs during development. Routes marked 'placeholder stub' return {status: placeholder_stub} - real logic hasn't been ported from the old Django views yet.
